tasks.title: Cosmetic test-fixture sweep across remaining test files
tasks.description: Mechanical rename of the remaining incidental '.ralph' fixture paths and test names across the suite — these are temp-dir names, not behavior, and they are what would otherwise make the manual post-round grep sweep non-empty. Files and approximate counts: test/commands/summarize.test.ts (21), test/commands/status.test.ts (17), test/commands/plan.test.ts (10), test/post-task-reviewer.test.ts (~26 remaining), test/commands/run.test.ts (remaining), test/commands/edit.test.ts (remaining), test/index.test.ts (remaining), test/config.test.ts and test/utils.test.ts (any stragglers). Do NOT re-touch test/commands/init.test.ts — task 54 owns it. Rename '.ralph' -> '.cairn' and 'ralph.json' -> 'cairn.json' in fixture paths and test names only. Assertions stay literal ('.cairn', 'cairn.json'), never BRAND.dataDir/BRAND.configFile. If any rename makes a test fail, that test was behavioral — STOP and report rather than editing assertions. Finish by running `grep -rni ralph test/` and reporting whatever is left. Do NOT modify cairn.json's healthCheck and do NOT run ./install.sh. Do not touch .cairn/tasks.completed.json, .cairn_iterations.log, .cairn_tasks_snapshot.json, .cairn/reviews/round-*.md, .ralph_task_*_notes.md, or audit/.
tasks.notes:
# Task #64 — Cosmetic test-fixture sweep across remaining test files

## Outcome

Full suite: **805 pass, 0 fail, 29 files** — identical to baseline before this
task (no regressions, no count change). Files actually modified (6 of the 9
in scope had something to change):

- test/commands/summarize.test.ts — 21/21 renamed (all incidental fixture dirs)
- test/commands/status.test.ts — 15/17 renamed (2 left: brand-leak checks,
  `not.toContain('ralph init'/'ralph plan')` — not fixture strings)
- test/commands/plan.test.ts — 10/10 renamed
- test/post-task-reviewer.test.ts — 25/25 renamed
- test/commands/run.test.ts — 15/33 renamed (18 left: legacy-fallback
  behavioral tests for the old temp-file prefix, the permanent
  `.ralph_task_<id>_notes.md` NOTES_TEMP_PREFIX exception, and one
  brand-name-leak check — see below)
- test/commands/edit.test.ts — 1/1 renamed

3 files in scope had **zero changes** because every occurrence was
behavioral, verified empirically (not just by inspection) in at least one
case:

- **test/config.test.ts** (6 occurrences) — all inside tests asserting
  `ralph.json`/`RALPH_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` are correctly *ignored* by current
  config resolution (`'ignores a ralph.json left behind by an unmigrated
  project'`, `'resolves to cairn.json even when only a ralph.json exists'`,
  `'ignores a RALPH_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY...'`). Renaming the fixture to
  `cairn.json`/`CAIRN_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` would make it the real resolved
  value and invert the test's assertion.
- **test/utils.test.ts** (5 occurrences) — all inside tests asserting
  `findDataDir`/`findProjectRoot`/`tempFilePath` are NOT tripped up by a
  leftover `.ralph`-named sibling. The agent empirically tried the rename and
  confirmed `'does not treat a legacy .ralph/ directory as a project root'`
  actually **fails** when renamed (child dir then also has a `.cairn`, so
  `findProjectRoot` resolves to the nearer child instead of the parent) —
  proof this is load-bearing, not incidental. Reverted, file left byte-for-byte
  original.
- **test/index.test.ts** (5 occurrences) — 1 is a brand-leak check
  (`not.toContain('Ralph')`), 4 are inside two tests explicitly titled
  `'never resolves to a leftover .ralph/ directory'` and `'points
  completedTasksPath at .cairn/ even when a leftover .ralph/ exists'` — the
  whole point of these tests is a `.ralph` dir coexisting with `.cairn`.

## Ambiguous case flagged, left alone

`test/commands/run.test.ts:315` —
`expect(prompt).not.toContain('.ralph/tasks.json directly')` inside
`'ban on direct tasks.json edits uses the resolved dataDir path, not a
hardcoded literal'`. This guards against the prompt-builder falling back to a
hardcoded old-brand literal instead of the dynamic `dataDir`, so it reads as a
regression guard rather than a pure fixture string. Left untouched per the
"lean toward leaving ambiguous ones alone" instruction — worth a second look
if a future round wants it renamed too, but low stakes either way since it's
asserting *absence* of a string, not fixture identity.

## Final sweep result

`grep -rni ralph test/` still returns hits, all outside this task's scope or
justified:

- **Out of file scope entirely** (not listed in task #64's file list, so left
  untouched): test/commands/init.test.ts (task #54 owns it, explicitly
  excluded), test/commands/logs.test.ts, test/commands/narrate.test.ts,
  test/narration.test.ts, test/brand.test.ts, test/install-script.test.ts.
- **In scope, justified** (see above): config.test.ts (6), utils.test.ts (5),
  index.test.ts (5), run.test.ts (18 remaining — legacy-prefix behavioral
  tests + the permanent NOTES_TEMP_PREFIX exception + 1 brand-leak check),
  status.test.ts (2 brand-leak checks).

None of the remaining hits are incidental fixture names — every one is either
a legacy-fallback-behavior test, the permanent `.ralph_` notes prefix
(NOTES_TEMP_PREFIX, per task #63), a brand-name-leak assertion, or a file this
task was told not to touch.

## Method

Delegated one subagent per file (9 in parallel) with explicit rules: rename
incidental `.ralph`/`ralph.json` fixture/test-name strings, leave
legacy-fallback-behavior tests and BRAND.dataDir/BRAND.configFile assertions
alone, run that file's tests after editing, revert on any newly-failing test.
Verified myself afterward with a full `grep -rni ralph test/` sweep and a full
`bun test` run (805 pass, 0 fail — matches pre-task baseline).

## Constraints honoured

Did not modify `cairn.json`'s `healthCheck`, did not run `./install.sh`, did
not touch `tasks.completed.json`, `.cairn_iterations.log`,
`.cairn_tasks_snapshot.json`, `.cairn/reviews/round-*.md`, other
`.ralph_task_*_notes.md`, `audit/`, or `test/commands/init.test.ts`.

tasks.title: Decide the fate of resolveAnthropicApiKeyChain — no production callers remain
tasks.description: Task #51 deleted warnIfLegacyApiKey and its two call sites (src/commands/narrate.ts, src/commands/run.ts), which were the only consumers of resolveAnthropicApiKeyChain(). The function is still exported from src/config.ts and covered by test/config.test.ts, but nothing in src/ calls it — the resolution is now purely documentary, mirroring the same chain in lib/cairn_narrate_server.py (see task #59). Either (a) delete the helper, its AnthropicApiKeyResolution type, and its tests, leaving the Python server as the single implementation, or (b) keep it and give it a real caller — e.g. have runNarrate/runRun pass the resolved key into the narration server env instead of relying on the child process re-reading the environment. Do NOT normalize onto plain ANTHROPIC_API_KEY under either option: the loop deliberately blanks that name to force Max-plan usage. Sequence this after #59 so both sides of the mirror are decided together.
